programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687629/attempts/1a23792c575c414fa559b68921d57662/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full separator rows/columns split the canvas into matching panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != grid[0][0]]
    # Also recognize separators by being constant and occurring as a line amid panels.
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Any full constant row/col between panels acts as a divider; ARC backgrounds
    # can vary, so use the constant-line pattern rather than a fixed color.
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only lines that split the grid (not uniform outer panel content).
    def segments(n, cuts):
        edges = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(edges[i]+1, edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(edges)-1) if edges[i]+1 < edges[i+1]]
    # For the task separator is a full 3-line; constant lines within panels
    # are not present. Treat all constant lines as dividers, excluding separator cells.
    rs = segments(h, row_cuts)
    cs = segments(w, col_cuts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Source is the final panel in both dimensions, replicated by local offset.
    sr0, sr1 = rs[-1]
    sc0, sc1 = cs[-1]
    ph, pw = sr1-sr0, sc1-sc0
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            if r1-r0 != ph or c1-c0 != pw:
                continue
            for dr in range(ph):
                for dc in range(pw):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = grid[sr0+dr][sc0+dc]
    return out
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_cuts = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    def segments(n, cuts):
        edges = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(edges[i]+1, edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(edges)-1) if edges[i]+1 < edges[i+1]]
    rs, cs = segments(h, row_cuts), segments(w, col_cuts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    sr0, sr1 = rs[-1]
    sc0, sc1 = cs[-1]
    ph, pw = sr1-sr0, sc1-sc0
    for r0, r1 in rs:
        for c0, c1 in cs:
            if r1-r0 == ph and c1-c0 == pw:
                for dr in range(ph):
                    for dc in range(pw):
                        out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = grid[sr0+dr][sc0+dc]
    return out
'''
